subject: Service impact during partner demo — proposed remediation and credits
messages:
From: Simon Price <simon@haloretail.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Haley Jordan <haley.ops@haloretail.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: urgent — demo interrupted by timeouts

Evelyn,

Quick note from this morning's integration demo: between 08:40 and 09:05 PT our engineering team saw repeated 5xx responses and timeouts when hitting the Redwood generation endpoint we were trialing. The demo was for a prospective buyer and the impact was visible on screen — they paused the meeting and asked us to follow up.

Haley captured logs and attached a short timeline. We need confirmation that this was on your side (routing/capacity) and, if so, what remediation you can offer — our procurement team is asking about credits for the disruption and an additional trial window so we can reschedule the buyer demo without losing momentum.

Simon
Head of Engineering, Halo Retail
[attachment: outage_timeline.docx (DOCX, 45KB)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Simon Price <simon@haloretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: urgent — demo interrupted by timeouts

Hi Simon — thanks for flagging this and for the timeline. I'm really sorry this happened during a buyer-facing demo; I know how disruptive that can be.

Preliminary update: our control plane metrics show elevated queueing on the regional pool serving your trial region between 08:35–09:08 PT due to an autoscaler lag during a sudden burst in ephemeral demos. That caused degraded tail latency and a handful of 5xx retries. We pushed a fast fix at 09:12 PT to bump burst capacity and stabilize the pool.

Proposal to make this right:
- Immediate: issue a one-time credit equal to 25% of October usage (applied to the next invoice) to account for the impacted window.
- Trial extension: extend your trial window by 14 days so Halo can re-run the buyer demo without time pressure.
- Follow-up: I'll loop in our SRE and product ops for a short postmortem and share the incident timeline and mitigations by EOD Monday.

If that proposal sounds reasonable I'll route this for expedited approval — looping Marissa for commercial confirmation and Karthik for manager sign-off on the credit.

Apologies again — we want to make sure your buyer gets a smooth replay.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
[attachment: request_for_evidence.zip (ZIP, 120KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 13:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: urgent — demo interrupted by timeouts

Evelyn / Marissa — thanks for the quick triage. I reviewed the control plane notes and agree this is an appropriate customer remediation. A few quick asks before we confirm:
1) Confirm the exact credit amount in dollars or percent and that Finance is fine applying it to the next invoice (we've used % credits for trial-related interruptions historically).
2) Please confirm trial extension dates (14 days starting from 2026-10-03?).
3) Add the postmortem summary (2–3 bullets) for the customer so they can share internally if needed.

If Marissa signs off on the commercial terms I'll approve the credit.

Karthik Iyer
Director, North America Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Simon Price <simon@haloretail.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: urgent — demo interrupted by timeouts

Simon / Haley — thanks for the patience and for sharing the logs. We reviewed this with Finance and SRE. Confirming the remediation below:

- Credit: 25% credit applied to Halo Retail's October usage (will appear on next invoice as a credit line item).
- Trial extension: 14-day extension granted, new trial window will end 2026-10-17 (original trial expiry preserved if later, we applied additive days).
- Postmortem summary (for your internal notes):
  • Root cause: autoscaler lag on regional pool during a burst of demo traffic caused queueing and elevated tail latency.
  • Immediate fix: manual burst-capacity override at 09:12 PT and mitigation flags to prioritize control-plane autoscale backfill.
  • Next steps: product will add a faster fallback policy for demo-tier workloads and SRE will run load-surge drills next month.

We applied the credit and updated your account — HubSpot ref HS-55421 reflects the activity. I've attached the incident timeline and the evidence bundle for your records. Let me know if you want a short sync (15 min) to rehearse the demo after the window.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
